card.name: Lead-in before listed interacting drug classes
card.fires_on: Small linking tokens such as "(", "e.g.,", "such as" and "of" that come right before a list of example drugs in interaction text. Typical lists are potassium-sparing diuretics, opioids with benzodiazepines, or CNS depressants.

modes.label: Example-introducing punctuation
modes.description: An opening bracket, "e.g.," or "such as" that introduces named example drugs.

modes.label: "Use of" before drug pairs
modes.description: The word "of" after "concomitant use" just before opioids and benzodiazepines are named.
